siteDescription: Frontend developer specializing in Vue & Nuxt, building fast, accessible interfaces with an engineer's rigor and an eye for detail.
heroTitle: Crafting frontends with the discipline of an engineer.
heroSubtitle: I'm a frontend developer specializing in Vue and Nuxt — crafting fast, accessible, and maintainable interfaces. I bring an engineer's mindset to every project: clean architecture, attention to detail, and code built to last.
about: I'm Mohamed Essam, a frontend developer who treats interfaces as engineering problems. With deep expertise in Vue and Nuxt, I build products that are not only beautiful and intuitive, but also performant, accessible, and built on solid architecture. I care as much about clean, maintainable code as I do about the experience it delivers.
